decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel remains central to the firm's secure-ecosystem strategy and costs little to maintain, although its absence from the website since 2020 suggests weaker prominence.
Mobile PDF signing supports the firm's push toward online contract signing as a low-cost feature, but its lack of visibility in 2020–2021 raises doubt that it is creating distinct value.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is a platform foundation for the other offers, so abandoning it would destroy many follow-on options.
After four years without visible traction, the niche email-to-app delivery robot appears to have shown that its value is unlikely to be realized, so its resources are better redeployed.
With PSD2 strong customer authentication now largely implemented through app-based methods, the costlier QR hardware token's uncertainty has resolved against it.
Ongoing payment compliance requirements keep the suite's value plausible at moderate cost, even though its visibility has declined.
